title: Copy reachable records between spaces
description: You can follow root relocation and pointer updates in the simulated copying collector.

steps.description: CheneyHeap divides its address range into two spaces. Allocation advances bump, and roots map names to addresses.
_copy assigns a new address and leaves a forwarding address in the old record. Repeated copies use that forwarding address.
collect copies roots, then scans new records. This simulation treats an integer field as a pointer when its value is an existing address.

steps.question: Which address range is cleared after swapping the space starts?
steps.answer: The former from-space, now identified by to_start, is cleared.

steps.description: The collector updates bump to the end of copied records. Its live count is the used portion of the new allocation space.
The supplied run starts with four allocated records and keeps two. Root y moves to 8 and its car field changes to the copied number's address 9.
